evidence:
SOURCE. tests/scoring.toml:1-3 '[gates] render = 0.0 / constraints = 0.0'; :5-8 weights functional 0.6, polish 0.2, visual 0.2 (sum 1.0, no gate name in [weights]); :10-11 '[floors] functional = 0.05'. This is the skill's delivery profile and staged-task-contract.md:82-96 verbatim. scoring.toml, tools/score.py, test.sh and tools/restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (sha256 95f70d6e..., 13de2b38..., bd682592... match both the template copies and manifest.json lines 42-45/78-81). Gates before shaping: test.sh:212 'rm -rf "$LOG_DIR/scored"' then :213 'if ! run_suite gates 1500; then exit 0' (plain zero written at :60 stays), :217 score.py, :220 '1) exit 0 ;;' so a failed gate ends the run before :224 'run_suite scored 11100' is ever launched; :221 any other scorer status rewrites the plain zero. score.py:41 'gates_passed = all(scores[k] > floor ...)', :42-44 scored dimensions forced to 0.0 unless gates passed and scored ran, :46 weighted sum iterates only over [weights] so gates hold no mass, :47-48 'reward = round(weighted, 4) if gates_passed and floors_passed else 0.0' with a strict '>' floor, :83 exit 1 on gate failure. Both gate judge.toml files use aggregation = "all_pass" with one binary criterion (gates/render/judge.toml:14-21, gates/constraints/judge.toml:14-21); no [judge] block in any of the five judge.toml files carries weight/model/temperature/reasoning keys. Each scored prompt restates the in-dimension gate that zeroes a blank/static shell (functional/prompt.md:13-15, polish/prompt.md:11-12, visual/prompt.md:11-12 'minimum raw Likert score1, which normalizes to zero').

EXECUTED (local, no Docker, no provider): I copied the frozen scoring.toml and score.py to the session scratchpad and ran score.py against synthetic suite outputs. Results: render=0 with a full-marks scored file present -> reward 0.0, gates_passed 0, all scored dimensions 0.0, exit 1; constraints=0 -> reward 0.0, exit 1; gates pass and no scored output -> reward 0.0, floors_passed 0; functional 0.04 with polish 1/visual 1 -> reward 0.0 although weighted_score 0.424; functional exactly 0.05 -> reward 0.0 (strict floor); functional 0.066, polish 0, visual 0.75 -> reward 0.1896; all 1.0 -> reward 1.0; gate key missing -> exit 2, which test.sh:221 turns into the plain zero. This is an execution of the scoring arithmetic only, not of test.sh, RewardKit or a judge.

FLOOR VERSUS A GATE-ONLY APP (my weight arithmetic over the 152 functional criteria, total weight 64.404; floor needs more than 3.22). A broken-but-plausible app that passes both gates (sign-in, server-backed requisition and pending-offer creation, a styled workspace) and nothing else can at most collect raise-role rows (~0.46), hro_req_create_recruiter and hro_referrer_roster (0.02), the anonymous-read rows it can populate plus status (up to ~0.96), anonymous requisition/offer creation refusal (0.39), date rows (0.36) and creation validation (0.09): about 2.3/64.4 = 3.5%, under the 5% floor, so its visual score is discarded and reward is 0. Approval, revision, rescission and every coordinated-change/desk row need real settlement logic. The cheap gates therefore earn nothing by themselves, matching the internal annotation. The floor is first crossed when the app also shows the P3 composition figures correctly (hro_intrinsic/annual/runrate/basis/bands, 5 x 0.482 = 2.41, 'No approval needed for these display facts', functional/prompt.md:31), giving roughly 7%. Such an app has working shared storage, auth and correct valuation arithmetic, so I do not count it as the non-working app the row targets, but its reward would be about 0.04 from function plus up to 0.2 from visual (polish rows all require coordinated commits and stay 0). That is a consequence of the template-fixed 0.05 floor and 0.2 visual share, which this review may not alter; whether those shares are honest belongs to rows 42 and 44.

CONFORMING ALTERNATIVE THAT COULD FAIL: the constraints gate asks for requisition plus pending-offer creation and fresh-context readback and explicitly forbids demanding labels, routes, ID formats or a DB engine (gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-25); I found no gate demand that would zero a conforming app for an implementation choice. A judge/tool failure in a gate yields binary 0 (gates/render/prompt.md:11), which zeroes the whole reward; that is the shared template policy and an evaluator-reliability exposure rather than a row-43 wiring defect.

NOT MEASURED: raw-evidence-index.json states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and target/Oracle scores are absent'. No configured verifier run shows a gate-failing or gate-only submission actually receiving 0 through test.sh and RewardKit, and the 3.5% / 7% figures are my estimate from criterion text, not judge output. Pass rests on source, template identity and the local scorer execution; risk stays true for the missing runtime discrimination evidence.
